title: Luv U Honey | Renovated Beachside Seaside Cottage| Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Experience Luv U Honey, a renovated Seaside cottage beachside on 30A. Perfect for a peaceful and relaxing vacation.
description_expanded: Luv U Honey Features: - Fully renovated for 2026 including a brand new full-size kitchen with Sub-Zero appliances and THREE Deluxe Suites. Updated photos coming summer 2026. - 260 Feet to Shopping and Dining in the heart of Seaside - 32 steps to the iconic East Ruskin Beach Pavilion - Access to 4 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep in top shape - Dedicated parking for 2 vehicle in driveway - Full kitchen with Wolf Gas Range and Oven, Sub-Zero refrigerator and Sub-Zero wine refrigerator - Cable and WIFI plus Smart TVs throughout the home - Screened-in patio with outdoor dining and outdoor shower - Deluxe showers fitted with oversized rain and handheld shower heads -Access to Seaside Tennis and Fitness Center included with your reservation. Schedule tennis lessons or rent court time on the Pickleball Courts -Concierge services including beach chair rentals, bike rentals, grocery delivery, and baby equipment rentals available - Golf cart rentals restricted in Seaside per the HOA (Medical exceptions may be granted on a limited basis) -Access to Seaside Beach private entrances and all Seaside community pools included with your reservation. Some pools heated during cooler months. Towel service available; subject to change by the HOA. - Area summer camps and kids' classes available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Enjoy the laid-back atmosphere and cottage vibes at this beachside vacation rental next to Seaside center. Our designer luxury cottage by the sea is the ultimate rental for a romantic 30A vacation. Currently being updated for an even more spacious and luxurious experience. Once complete, the home will comfortably sleep 8 in three suites feature a brand-new full kitchen with high-end appliances from Wolf, SubZero, and Cove plus fixtures from Kohler throughout the home. You'll savor the sound of the waves and the feeling of the Gulf breeze on the inviting screened-in porch, which is furnished with comfortable seating, an outdoor shower, and plenty of storage for your beach gear. Luv U Honey is next to the East Ruskin Pavilion Beach Access and less than a minute walk to Seaside restaurants, shops, and entertainment.

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
